# RepoExtraKind

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Community` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum RepoExtraKind
```

What kind of thing the repository holds that the gallery does not allow.

## Values

- <span id="f-file"></span>`File = 0` - A file or folder on the default branch (a folder is one item, named by its top-level path).
- <span id="f-branch"></span>`Branch = 1` - A branch other than the default one.
- <span id="f-release"></span>`Release = 2` - A Release no share lists.
- <span id="f-asset"></span>`Asset = 3` - A file attached to an allowed Release that is not `<slug>.set` or `preview.png`.
- <span id="f-tag"></span>`Tag = 4` - A tag that belongs to no allowed Release.
